items.title: Dutch-Bangla Bank offers personal, home loans at 8.99%
items.description: Dutch-Bangla Bank has announced a special lending scheme, offering personal and home loans at an interest rate of 8.99 percent to customers transferring their existing loans from other financial institutions.

items.title: Invest Bangladesh wins WAIPA award for LDC investment promotion
items.description: Invest Bangladesh, the national investment promotion and facilitation agency of the country, has won the “Outstanding LDC Investment Promotion Agency” award at the WAIPA Investment Excellence Awards in Geneva, Switzerland.

items.title: Govt expects progress on IMF programme by Jan 2027: Finance minister
items.description: The government expects to finalise a clear outline and achieve concrete progress on its ongoing programme with the International Monetary Fund (IMF) by January next year, Finance and Planning Minister Amir Khosru Mahmud Chowdhury said today

items.title: NRBC Bank launches six NRCT accounts for expatriates
items.description: NRBC Bank PLC has launched six types of Non-Resident Convertible Taka Accounts (NRCTAs) to expand savings and investment opportunities for Bangladeshi expatriates.
